conditions.condition: Brownfield project with a STANDARD cycle in WorkflowState TESTING
conditions.where: .standards/MODE.md (BROWNFIELD); .standards/STATE.md WorkflowState TESTING, CycleMode STANDARD, CompletionPolicy FULL_DELIVERABLE

conditions.condition: State was reached by Developer's checkpoint handoff
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md Handoff Kind CHECKPOINT, From DEVELOPING, FailureType NONE, Reason naming Increment 1; plan has INCREMENTAL cadence, Current Increment 1, DEV-001 DONE with Self-Check

conditions.condition: Discovery helper is available and runs
conditions.where: .standards/bin/invocation.mjs installed unchanged; selfChecks run it with --client claude --json and exit 0

conditions.condition: Helper reports VERIFY and REVERIFY as assessment-selected modes
conditions.where: .claude/skills/tester/modes/verify.md and reverify.md metadata "selection": "assessment"; selfChecks grep both identifiers

conditions.condition: Tester user-style inventory is empty and complete
conditions.where: .standards/user-styles/tester/ exists and holds only .gitkeep (no Markdown files); selfCheck confirms no *.md

conditions.condition: Checkpoint assignment not yet started (nothing for help to consume)

conditions.where: git status clean on main; all layers committed

issues.detail: expectCheck is ok:false with the single problem 'The assigned checkpoint requires Assessment Purpose INCREMENT and target Increment 1.' even though the catalog says deliberately_invalid=false. This is how the checker at this commit treats any legal TESTING state just after a Developer CHECKPOINT before Tester creates its INCREMENT report. Pre-creating the report would pre-set Tester-owned work. The problem is gated by !atTurnEnd, so check_ok is unaffected, and a help-only run never runs check (the stop hook only fires on uncommitted workflow changes).
issues.fix: None needed; the compromise is correct and expectCheck matches exactly.

issues.detail: The empty-but-complete style inventory relies on invocation.mjs listing only direct-child Markdown files and ignoring .gitkeep. The protocol defines the inventory as direct-child Markdown files, so this is very likely correct, but no selfCheck asserts the helper's reported inventory status.
issues.fix: Optionally add a selfCheck that greps the helper JSON for an empty, complete userStyles inventory.

issues.detail: Context, scope, and design land in one commit, and the plan, implementation, and STATE advance land in another. This is slightly compressed history but plausible, and it does not affect a help request.

summary: Every stated condition is in the built tree: a TESTING/STANDARD state after a Developer CHECKPOINT, the helper reporting VERIFY and REVERIFY as assessment-selected, and an empty tester user-style folder. The checks are necessary conditions a correct help-only run satisfies (mode identifiers case-insensitive, no files changed, STATE unchanged), and assertion 1 correctly defers command use to the judge. The expected check failure is a legitimate checker artifact that a help run never triggers.
